task.description:
Fix two issues causing 13 Playwright E2E test failures for Stage F2 requirements PD-UI-01 through PD-UI-04:

Issue 1 (root cause - 11 failures): POST /definitions returns 400 'malformed_json' when the request body does not include a `graph` field. The backend CreateDefinitionBody requires `{name, version, description, graph}` with graph requiring nodes and edges. However, the frontend creates a definition first (before the user adds nodes to the canvas), so graph should be optional at creation time. Fix the backend handler in src/api/routes/definitions.zig to accept a request without `graph` (defaulting to empty graph).

Issue 2 (2 failures): The definition list page at web/src/pages/definitions/DefinitionListPage.tsx does not render a DOM element with data-testid='filter-bar'. Add the data-testid attribute to the filter/search section of the page.

After fixing, validate:
cd web
npm run type-check
npm run lint
npm run build
acceptance_criteria: POST /definitions accepts body without graph field (returns 201, not 400)

result.summary: Fixed Category A (logic error) and Category D (test attr missing) in definitions.zig and DefinitionListPage.tsx: made graph field optional in CreateDefinitionBody so POST /definitions accepts bodies without graph (defaults to empty {nodes:[], edges:[]}); added data-testid=filter-bar to filter container div. Also fixed 6 pre-existing lint errors (unused request param) in f2-definition-list.e2e.spec.ts. All validations pass: zig build, npm run type-check, npm run lint, npm run build.
